prerequisites.reason: Gradient descent in machine learning is used to minimize a loss function, so the objective being minimized must be understood first.
Understanding the basic structure and purpose of neural networks is necessary before studying their architectural design choices.
Gradient noise concerns variability in gradient estimates during optimization, which requires understanding gradient-based optimization first.
Eigenvalues are often used to analyze the behavior and convergence of gradient-based optimization methods.
Training dynamics involve changes in model performance during training, which are measured and guided by loss functions.
Training dynamics commonly depend on how gradient-based updates evolve during model training.
